description:
Use this when the user wants a clip called something else: "rename this clip", "call it Clutch ace". Only
the Library name changes; the answer gives the old title.
Not for: a post's caption (update_draft). Free: no Horizon Units.

clip_id.description: Clip or saved photo id from list_clips.

title.description: The new name, 1 to 140 characters, e.g. Clutch ace.
